description: This file defines classes and functions related to interceptable network requests in WebKit within the Playwright project. It includes handling of request creation, response generation, request interception, and error handling, specifically tailored for WebKit browser engine integration.

classes.name: WKInterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request in WebKit, capable of creating responses and managing request lifecycle.

classes.name: WKRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route delegate for intercepting, fulfilling, and continuing requests in WebKit.

methods.name: adoptRequestFromNewProcess
methods.description: Adopts the request from a new process session, updating internal session and request ID.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a network response object based on the response payload, fetching response body asynchronously.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the request with a specified error code, translating it to a Protocol.Network.ResourceErrorType.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills the request with a specified response, handling headers, status, and body.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues the request with optional overrides for URL, method, headers, and post data.
